plan_a_advantages: Includes tempo intervals for speed development.
Features two longer runs, allowing for greater endurance building.
More directly targets the goal of becoming a faster trail runner.
plan_b_advantages: Prioritizes injury prevention with strength and cross-training.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates dedicated tempo intervals and longer runs at controlled efforts, directly addressing the goal of increasing speed and endurance. Plan B, while prioritizing injury prevention and aerobic base building, lacks the specific speed work needed for improvement. Plan A’s focus on sharpening speed with tempo runs and longer, more challenging runs is crucial for a runner seeking to increase their pace on the trails. Furthermore, the inclusion of a second longer run provides more opportunity for building endurance.
